name: Custom 4-Layer Wooden Shelf Display
description:
KEY FEATURES

  • Premium Material:
    - Crafted from high-quality wood, offering durability and a warm rustic appearance.
    - The product features a 4-layer wooden construction, creating a deep shadow-box style display.
    - Each wooden layer has a 3 mm thickness, precisely laser-cut for accurate detailing and a clean finish.
    - The outer wooden frame includes rounded corners and a thicker structure, creating a 3D box-like effect for the display.
    - Smooth edges and sturdy craftsmanship ensure safe handling and long-lasting durability.

 

  • Sizes & Dimensions:
    - Overall Dimensions: 6.2 x 6.2 in x 1.2 in ~15.75 x 15.75 cm x 3.06 cm.
    - Inner Display Area: 6 x 6 in ~ 15.24 x 15.24 cm.
    📌 Note: The shape is fixed and cannot be changed. Customers can only customize the print design and the details inside.

 

  • Printing Technology:
    - Produced using advanced UV printing technology to deliver vibrant colors and sharp design details.
    - Layer 1 (background layer): supports 2-sided printing.
    - Layer 2, layer 3, layer 4: 1-sided printing for decorative elements.
    - The printing process ensures high-definition artwork, fade resistance, and long-lasting color quality.
    - Laser-cut technology guarantees precise shapes and detailed layered construction.

 

  • Functional & Usage:
    - Designed as a decorative shelf display or shadow box decoration.
    - The layered wooden structure creates a 3D depth effect, making the design visually striking.
    - Perfect for displaying on desks, shelves, cabinets, or workshop spaces.
    - Suitable for home décor, office décor, hobby rooms, or personalized display collections.

 

  • Perfect Gift for Any Occasion:
    - A thoughtful gift for family members, friends, or loved ones.
    - Ideal for Father’s Day, birthdays, anniversaries, housewarming gifts, or hobby-themed celebrations.
    - Perfect for people who enjoy craftsmanship, personalized décor, or workshop-themed decorations.
    - Combines artistic design, sentimental value, and decorative functionality, making it a meaningful keepsake.🎁

 

SPECIFICATION

  • Processing Time: 1 – 3 working days on average after payment and all designs updated correctly
  • Shipping Time: 6 – 9 working days on average (US)
  • Packaging: 1 x Custom 4-Layer Wooden Shelf Display

 

PRODUCTION

  • Manufacturer: Made by Printway
  • The tracking Country Origin is the US

Print Guidelines

Below is our complete selection of art templates used for designing within the full printable area of our products. Each template comes with a .png detailing Safe Area, Bleed, etc. Download templates and mockups here

 

To use an Art Template:

  • Open the Printway template for your selected product in Photoshop or another design program.
  • Insert your artwork in a new layer, placing all important parts of your design within the designated “Safe zone” on the art template to ensure your design will not be cut off during the printing process.
  • If you’re designing drinkware, use the indicated centering lines to ensure your artwork is placed exactly where you’d like.
  • Hide or delete the Art Template layer from your file.
  • Save as a .png, .jpg, or another accepted file type.
  • You’ve now used a Printway template to create artwork exactly to the recommended specs for that product.

 

To ensure your design prints properly on each product:

  • Ensure all important elements of your design are within the safe zone on the product template.
  • Fill the entire design template! The outer edge of the template represents “Bleed Area,” which signifies the areas which may print on the outer edges of your product.
  • Failure to fill the bleed area will likely result in unprinted white unprinted areas around the edge of your product.
